title: urginea maritima var. numidica
intro: Urginea maritima var. numidica, commonly known as Numidian squill, is a plant species in the Asparagaceae family. It is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Urginea maritima var. numitica include its potential to reduce inflammation and improve cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of the plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include alkaloids such as galantamine, and its ability to exhibit cardiotonic, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic properties.
